snapshotKernelAlternatingSameProcess.scope: Alternating batches in one process; 240 nodes, 48 overlaid per frame; snapshot capture/restore only

cpu.interpretation: Separate-process measurements are variable: final-after1 balance has a large mean/p95 spike; the longer separate balance pair also regresses (mean +74.3%, median +15.4%). Do not discard these or attribute them to GC/OS without evidence. Follow-up sampling shows less restore/name-collection work. Alternating two production Players with separate module graphs in one process gives mean paired balance-incident CPU -15.0%, median paired -15.9%; step means -15.8%. This paired experiment helps control run-to-run conditions but has different memory/module-graph conditions. No browser FPS, total-heap or universal CPU-speedup claim.

nextFidelity.userSteering: Make knee-only landings/recoveries substantially rarer. Balance/manual bails may fully fall over and take an extra beat. Carry rebound/steadying motion through the return to standing/running instead of perfectly extinguishing momentum.
nextFidelity.when: Next fidelity pass after current CPU/stability pass is validated and committed.
nextFidelity.balanceDirection: Balance bails must follow the direction of lost balance. Backward manual failure sends the board slipping/pinging forward while skater falls backward. Nose-manual failure reverses this: skater falls forward and board slips/pings backward.

delivery: Task-only local follow-up on codex/fluid-intact-bails. Preserve shared checkout/index and unrelated work. No remote transfer; goal remains active.
